description: Expected results for the official EPANET 2.2 tutorial network (User_Manual/docs/tutorial.inp of USEPA/EPANET2.2, the example input of the User Manual Appendix C): 5 junctions, 1 reservoir, 1 tank, 6 pipes, 1 pump, 24 h extended-period run with chlorine decay. inputs/ is the unmodified official file. Checks marked 'official' take their value from reference/tutorial.out, the official report excerpt that ships next to the input in the same repo (printed in the manual). Checks marked 'own run' (24 h values and period counts, which the excerpt does not cover) were recorded from a real run of the server engine; two clean runs gave identical reports (only date/path header lines differ), so the run is deterministic.
engine_version: EPANET 2.2.0 (USEPA/EPANET2.2 git 598ee6c), runepanet + libepanet2.so built on this server
